text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING P1 — metering: token_count delta >45% vs ledger (eu1) over last 12m. Multiple overage flags firing. Auto-runbook: #/runbooks/metering-drift. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/metrics/metering-delta
mel: ack oncall SRE (mel) — joining. pulling traces and consumer metrics now.
arjun: looking, kafka consumer lag is small. initial spike looks like duplicate emissions — pattern: same request-id repeated 2-3x in emitter logs.
mel: @billing-eng any deploys to emitter in past 60m? customer-notifs already triggering?
billing-eng: rolled emitter v2 2026-03-18T17:02Z then rolled back at 17:12Z after alert. logs show retry loop from emitter -> proxy causing duplicate writes. investigating root cause.
mel: mitigation plan: 1) suppress overage notifications for affected accounts 2) disable emitter retries in eu1 3) run dedupe/reconcile job 4) notify CS for customer comms.
mel: disabling retries now (eu1):
```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/emitters/eu1/retries:disable
{"reason":"incident 1752229999 - disable retries to stop duplicate token emits"}
```
cs_triage: starting suppression: patching accounts with active overage emails to not notify while we reconcile. Command: `PATCH /api/v1/accounts?overage_notify=false&source=incident` — will follow up with list.
billing-eng: deployed hotfix to emitter to add idempotency key check, pushed canary to eu1. also turned off exponential retries at the proxy. logs show duplicate emission rate dropping ~65% since 17:20Z.
arjun: quick debug snippet from emitter logs: `2026-03-18T17:05:12Z emitter: WARN emit_retry request_id=abc123 attempts=3 -> duplicate write succeeded` — looks like missing idempotency on retry path.
mel: kicked off dedupe job (dedupe_v2) in metering DB. SQL run submitted: ```INSERT INTO metering.dedupe_runs(run_id, started_by, query) VALUES('run-1752229999','mel','-- dedupe tokens by request_id timestamp window');``` ETA ~3-6h to finish full backfill for last 24h.
arjun: reconciliation progress: 45% of affected shard processed, estimated time remaining ~1h15m. We'll stream progress to the runbook.
billing-eng: suppressing new overage flagging globally for eu1 while reconcile runs to avoid more false alerts. We will re-enable once dedupe completes and counts reverify.
incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled on-call handoff to @sre_lead in 30m — update handoff notes in the incident channel.
mel: current state: retries disabled, hotfix deployed, dedupe job running, overage notification suppressed, customer-impact assessment in progress. Moving to monitoring/mitigation mode.
cs_triage: drafting customer outbound: neutral explain + apology + credits. ETA to customers: initial note in ~45m, full reconciliation ETA 3-6h.
arjun: root cause looks like a race in emitter retry circuit combined with missing idempotency token on proxy errors. tracking in issue RED-7321.
mel: will own postmortem and runbook updates. handing incident to @sre_lead for overnight watch and followups. please add any missed items to the runbook thread. :thumbsup:
sre_lead: taking over — thanks @mel. will monitor reconcile progress and coordinate final re-enable of overage flags. please leave latest logs + runbook link in the thread.
incident-bot: PAGING cleared (mitigation engaged) — keep channel open for updates.
